items.title: Derek Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 5, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Very significant. I did the same thing with Cannonball Adderley. Talking about filling the horn. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: wanted to like, hey are there transcription books with this? I want to play along with this. And then I remember taking the CD and this little boom box that I had and I would go out to the garage, and this was in Michigan and in the winter it would get really cold in the garage, but it didn’t matter, I would go in that garage because it had the best acoustics in the house, you know this nice reverb. And I would put on that Dave Koz and I had my little transcription book and I would just close my eyes and play.…
Very significant. I did the same thing with Cannonball Adderley. Talking about filling the horn.
